cases.name: prompt-handoffs_step_execution
cases.detail:
timed out waiting for three queued prompts and task one ready; last pane output: # cd /opt/testbed; export ATM_IDENTITY=stub-beta; export ATM_TEAM=testbed
#

fixture_reset.command:
docker exec hermes-testbed sh -lc set -eu
herdr pane list 2>/dev/null | python3 -c '
import json, subprocess, sys
for pane in json.load(sys.stdin)["result"]["panes"]:
    subprocess.run(["herdr", "pane", "close", pane["pane_id"]], capture_output=True)
' 2>/dev/null || true
pkill -f '[h]ermes gateway run' 2>/dev/null || true
pkill -f '[h]erdr server' 2>/dev/null || true
pkill -x atm-daemon 2>/dev/null || true
for unused in $(seq 1 20); do
  pgrep -x atm-daemon >/dev/null 2>&1 || break
  sleep 1
done
rm -f /root/.atm/daemon/owner.lock /root/.atm/daemon/local-http.json
mkdir -p /root/.atm/logs
: > /root/.atm/logs/atm.log.jsonl
python3 -c 'import json
import sqlite3

connection = sqlite3.connect('"'"'/root/.atm/db/mail.db'"'"')
kept = ('"'"'graft_receiver_endpoints'"'"', '"'"'message_template_search_documents'"'"', '"'"'message_templates'"'"', '"'"'message_templates_fts'"'"', '"'"'message_templates_fts_config'"'"', '"'"'message_templates_fts_data'"'"', '"'"'message_templates_fts_docsize'"'"', '"'"'message_templates_fts_idx'"'"', '"'"'peer_https_interfaces'"'"', '"'"'peer_local_certificate'"'"', '"'"'peer_trusted_peers'"'"', '"'"'search_projection_schema'"'"', '"'"'team_roster'"'"')
classified = set(('"'"'prompt_handoffs'"'"', '"'"'task_events'"'"', '"'"'tasks'"'"', '"'"'escalation_recipients'"'"', '"'"'mail_message_states'"'"', '"'"'mail_messages'"'"', '"'"'mail_seen_watermarks'"'"', '"'"'mail_message_search_documents'"'"', '"'"'team_nudge_template_overrides'"'"', '"'"'diagnostic_events'"'"')) | set(('"'"'mail_messages_fts'"'"', '"'"'mail_messages_fts_config'"'"', '"'"'mail_messages_fts_data'"'"', '"'"'mail_messages_fts_idx'"'"')) | set(kept)
actual = {row[0] for row in connection.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = '"'"'table'"'"' AND name NOT LIKE '"'"'sqlite_%'"'"'")}
if actual != classified:
    raise SystemExit(f'"'"'unclassified migrated tables: {sorted(actual ^ classified)}'"'"')
before = {table: connection.execute(f'"'"'SELECT * FROM {table} ORDER BY 1'"'"').fetchall() for table in kept}
connection.executescript('"'"'PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;\nBEGIN IMMEDIATE;\nDELETE FROM prompt_handoffs;\nDELETE FROM task_events;\nDELETE FROM tasks;\nDELETE FROM escalation_recipients;\nDELETE FROM mail_message_states;\nDELETE FROM mail_messages;\nDELETE FROM mail_seen_watermarks;\nDELETE FROM mail_message_search_documents;\nDELETE FROM team_nudge_template_overrides;\nDELETE FROM diagnostic_events;\nCOMMIT;\nPRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE);'"'"')
after = {table: connection.execute(f'"'"'SELECT * FROM {table} ORDER BY 1'"'"').fetchall() for table in kept}
if not before['"'"'peer_local_certificate'"'"'] or after != before:
    raise SystemExit('"'"'reset changed required peer, roster, or interface metadata'"'"')
print('"'"'reset preserved metadata: '"'"' + json.dumps({table: len(rows) for table, rows in after.items()}, sort_keys=True))'
/opt/testbed/harness/bringup.sh
